items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Gene Cedric was with Fats Waller; Interviewee confirms the lineup but does not mention a personal connection or collaboration with Gene Cedric.

ctx.x: Could be, could be, yeah, it must be because he must have gone into Cafe Society about 1941. But this is not -- I'm not sure that these guys played -- it doesn't seem to me that these guys were at Cafe Society at the time. They were probably just a bunch of guys that got together and made this tape.
Yeah, Gene Cedric was with Fats Waller (Unintelligible)

That's right and Edward Barksdale on Guitar, Sidney Bechet, but I think Sidney was with Cafe Society for a while and so did Sidney de Paris and Wilbur de Paris and Wellman Braud on bass and Eddie Dougherty on drums.
